encoding: A255,R flags(crew1/knee2),G shade0..255,B cuff flags(crew1/knee2)+rib4. A0 copies input.

scope.male: Existing wardrobe coverage bit4 only, excluding all fabric labels and source transparent pixels.
scope.female: Existing fabric region2 only. This is an overlay on original tights; existing visible ankle skin remains unchanged.
scope.invariants: Never extend source alpha or touch source shoes, soles, outline, face, hair, or original files. Occluded leg segments may have zero labels.

authoring: Fixed source-bound labels from manually proposed axes; no rig, hidden skin, or new source pixels.
